text_blocks.text:
My therapist saved
my relationship, he said:

“Theres a time in the relationship
where all you’ll feel is love and
comfort. And theres going to be a
time where all you’ll feel is anger,
distance, and discomfort. All of
those emotions are drowning out
of love. In that moment you’re
going to want to quit. Don’t.”
